assessment_objectives.objective: an inventory of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) is maintained and is dynamically updated as assets are added, changed or removed.

the contextual attributes to be captured for each inventoried Technology Asset, Application, Service and/or Data (TAASD) entry (e.g., owner, location, criticality, data sensitivity, dependencies, software and configuration details) are defined and populated.
inventory data is used to detect anomalies, including unknown, unexpected or non-conforming assets.
inventory data is used to manage vulnerabilities, including identifying affected assets and prioritizing remediation.
inventory data is used to maintain compliance, including determining which assets are within the scope of statutory, regulatory and/or contractual obligations.
inventory data is used to maintain resilient capabilities, including identifying the assets that support business-critical functions and their recovery.
